build_image: build a pretrained ResNet18-based visual stream network using ModelBuilder.build_image with optional weights
build_audio: build a pretrained ResNet18-based audio stream network using ModelBuilder.build_audio with optional weights
build_classifierNet: build a ClassifierNet with configurable input dimensions and class count using ModelBuilder.build_classifierNet
build_imageAudioNet: build an ImageAudioModel network with weight initialization using ModelBuilder.build_imageAudioNet
build_imageAudioClassifierNet: build an ImageAudioClassifyModel combining image-audio and classifier networks using ModelBuilder.build_imageAudioClassifierNet
